entities.summary: Frazer Clarke is a British professional boxer. At regional level, he has challenged three times for the British heavyweight title and twice for Commonwealth heavyweight title. As an amateur, he won a silver medal at the 2017 European Championships; gold at the 2018 Commonwealth Games; and bronze at the 2020 Olympics.
